supported_points: 2024 was the largest annual increase in renewable power capacity on record in this pack.
The annual increase and the expansion share should be treated as separate proof points.
The benchmark and the current ambition level should be framed as a delivery gap, not as the same number.
Permitting, grid investment, and financing are recurring deployment bottlenecks in the packaged notes.
Solar should be treated as the main growth engine in the current expansion cycle.
The coal-generation implication belongs late in the campaign arc, not in the first sentence.
Use the world rows for the broad generation trend and the China row for scale concentration.
Generation trend claims should stay tied to the packaged years rather than treated as timeless facts.
